key_insight: Welding engineering students largely reported that learning English parts of speech and basic sentence patterns supported their speaking.
engineering_relevance: The findings concern English instruction for welding engineering students, not welding processes or material performance.
method: Taught English parts of speech and basic sentence patterns.
Collected post-instruction questionnaires from 28 welding engineering students at Politeknik Perkapalan Negeri Surabaya.
Summarized student responses quantitatively using diagrams.
evidence_signal: Of 28 respondents, 78.6% reported understanding the basic patterns well, while 92.9% said learning them helped their English speaking.
watch_item: A small, single-program sample and self-reported outcomes do not establish objective speaking improvement or causality.
paper_title: Students’ Response Given by Welding Engineering Study Program at Politeknik Perkapalan Negeri Surabaya to the Study of Part of Speech in English Learning
